summary: Fastest Feudal in the game. Chinese collect tax gold with Imperial Officials and grab deer with Pro Scouts, and early pressure barely slows them because training units also makes tax.
openings: Pro Scouts: all on sheep, Feudal around 2:20 with the Imperial Academy touching the mill and wood line, 3 officials, 5 scouts taking 2 deer packs.
Tax aggression against slow starters (Byzantines, Delhi, 2 TC Abbasid): early range, barracks and stable, 4 officials, Pro Scouts delayed to 6 or 7 minutes.

spikes.label: Fastest Feudal
spikes.detail: Feudal at about 2:20 and Pro Scouts taking deer by about 5:30.
spikes.answer: Deny the Pro Scout deer with units.

spikes.label: Castle around 9 to 10
spikes.detail: They hit Castle around 9 to 10 minutes via the Imperial Palace and play knight plus archer.

spikes.label: Song and Yuan
spikes.detail: Song Dynasty comes once they farm, around 16 to 18 minutes, and Yuan Palace Guards come late at about 120 population.
spikes.answer: Do your damage before they settle into farms.

scout: Imperial Academy at their mill and wood line with scouts on deer means Pro Scouts
An early range, barracks and stable with extra officials means tax aggression

pairings.why: Their main Castle army, sometimes with spears or crossbows.
Their Feudal answer to javelin or longbow plus spear.

winConditions.detail: Tax gold that keeps flowing even while they fight.

howToBeat: Deny the Pro Scout deer with your army.
Their economy shrugs off light raids, so make each attack count.
